metadata.notes: Each run is a controlled conceptual dry-run, not an autonomous execution. Agent outputs are the formalized proposals/acceptances recorded in the corresponding Markdown run.

AG_GENEALOGY: detect multiple origins for same relational states
AG_EXPANSION: expose 3x3 state field and off-diagonal mismatch region
AG_REORGANIZATION: identify EQ/EQ as unique swap-fixed central state
AG_VALIDATOR: accept family refactor without semantic target leakage

refactor: four isolated equality/order proposition routes -> one three-state relation family
open_questions: Is the central internal state related to pair congruence at a deeper level?
rejected_inferences: Do not predeclare isosceles as canonical; derive centrality from swap symmetry.

runs.result_summary: Recovered the triangle LT/EQ/GT family and its equality/equality swap-fixed center from a deliberately banalized theorem graph.

AG_GENEALOGY: DECOMPILE object center and pair coincidence
detect correspondence topology differing mainly by role-domain separation
AG_REORGANIZATION: create F_CORRESPONDENCE_COMPLETION instead of analogy edge
AG_COMPILER: group SAS/SSS/ASA as different access masks to the same external completion state
AG_VALIDATOR: reject ISOSCELES = CONGRUENCE identity claim; accept shared deep family

refactor: OBJECT zero and PAIR coincidence become internal/external realizations of one correspondence-completion field
open_questions: Is equality itself too privileged in this deep family?
Can a distributed carrier support role alignment without equality?
rejected_inferences: Do not collapse internal and external realizations into one object identity.

runs.result_summary: Discovered a deeper correspondence-completion family connecting the internal triangle zero with external triangle-pair congruence.

AG_COMPLETION: reconstruct vertical-angle equality as common-whole completion readout
AG_GENEALOGY: detect equality can be input or generated readout
AG_EXPANSION: construct distributed role alignment across P/Q without angle equality
AG_COMPILER: discover INTERNAL / EXTERNAL_OVERLAY / DISTRIBUTED_CARRIER completion topologies
discover preserve-sign vs reverse-sign relation-transducer instances

refactor: correspondence-first ontology -> relational packet with role alignment, constraints, completion, readout
open_questions: Can distributed angular masks certify a global nonclosure state?
Does ASA become a member of a distributed host?
rejected_inferences: zero cross-packet residue does not yet imply parallelism

runs.result_summary: The transversal broke the equality-first ontology and introduced distributed role topology plus an anti-diagonal supplement family.

AG_COMPLETION: compile multiple distributed masks to one PARALLEL readout
AG_GENEALOGY: reconstruct parallel certification through a triangle closure that must fail
AG_REORGANIZATION: create shared two-carrier workspace instead of TRIANGLE~PARALLEL analogy edge
AG_EXPANSION: establish bidirectional rebase between distributed two-carrier and triangular-closure views
AG_VALIDATOR: certify ASA as conditionally valid distributed host member; keep reverse generation unavailable

refactor: global completion now tracks closure topology: coincidence, finite closure, distributed nonclosure
open_questions: Can a certified parallel host regenerate angular data?
Can SAS grow a second direction class?

runs.result_summary: Parallelism emerged as distributed nonclosure certified by angular masks through a failed triangle-closure counterfactual.

AG_COMPLETION: turn parallelism from terminal readout into generative angular host
AG_GENEALOGY: close ANGLE_PATTERN -> PARALLEL -> ANGLE_COMPLETION cycle while preserving acyclic proof provenance
AG_REORGANIZATION: distinguish cognitive cycle from logical circularity
AG_EXPANSION: identify direction-preservation + magnitude-preservation pressure around SAS
AG_COMPILER: compile ASA as full cognitive-cycle member
propose translated-segment / parallelogram host candidate for SAS

refactor: PARALLEL changes from certified readout to reusable generative host
open_questions: Does direction+magnitude preservation compile into a four-edge translation family?
rejected_inferences: Cognitive cycle must not be used as circular proof support.

runs.result_summary: I.29 closed the first full completion/evocation cycle and exposed SAS pressure toward translation/parallelogram structure.

AG_EXPANSION: construct 3x3 product of independent metric and angular registers
AG_GENEALOGY: separate simple-zero triangle genealogy from two-axis four-edge genealogy
AG_REORGANIZATION: discover two independent zero loci and their intersection
AG_COMPILER: create F_ZERO_ORGANIZATION; distinguish SIMPLE_ZERO and COMPOSITE_ZERO
AG_VALIDATOR: attach square/rhombus/rectangle semantic labels only after structural discovery

refactor: zero is no longer necessarily one central state; introduce zero loci and composite intersections
open_questions: Can a composite zero project richer zero profiles into triangular slices?
rejected_inferences: Do not assume all families are diagonal transducers like the triangle family.

runs.result_summary: The parallelogram domain produced a two-axis product family and the square as intersection of independent metric and angular zero loci.

AG_GENEALOGY: trace host composite-zero conditions into two triangle subworkspaces
AG_COMPLETION: recognize simultaneous intrinsic triangle zero and inherited angular zero
AG_REORGANIZATION: replace flat zero notion with ZERO_STRUCTURE carrying origin/projection/recomposition provenance

refactor: zero origin becomes explicit: intrinsic vs inherited; host zero may project to sub-Gestalten
open_questions: Can local zero profiles be recomposed back into a richer composite host?
rejected_inferences: Projection is not proof that every triangle-zero came historically from a square-like host.

runs.result_summary: Diagonal reinjection showed that zero conditions can be inherited from richer hosts and that one triangle may carry multiple zero provenances.

AG_COMPLETION: recompose global boundary metric zero from local triangle zeros
AG_EXPANSION: use independent angular condition to expose second global zero
AG_GENEALOGY: distinguish intrinsic, inherited, recomposed, propagated zero origins
AG_REORGANIZATION: treat RECOMPOSE_ZERO as nontrivial and host-sensitive rather than strict inverse of projection
AG_VALIDATOR: validate composite host only after both global zeros are independently supported

refactor: zero genealogy gains RECOMPOSED and PROPAGATED origins
open_questions: Without the extra angular condition, what is actually forced?
rejected_inferences: RECOMPOSE_ZERO is not a deterministic inverse of PROJECT_ZERO.

runs.result_summary: Two local triangle zeros recomposed a global metric-zero host; an independent angular condition then yielded the composite square-like zero.

AG_COMPLETION: stop at strongest licensed result: global metric zero only
AG_GENEALOGY: show local zeros + congruence do not genetically entail global angular zero
AG_REORGANIZATION: revise recomposition as host construction + free-register exposure
AG_COMPILER: promote ZeroLocus as first-class object; identify EQ as angular swap-fixed central candidate

refactor: RECOMPOSE_GESTALTS now returns strongest licensed host plus explicit free registers
CENTRALITY != ACTUALITY becomes a core invariant
open_questions: Which independent access masks can realize the angular zero locus?
Do diagonals/perpendicularity/second symmetry provide alternative access masks to the same zero?
rejected_inferences: Do not infer composite zero from local zeros plus congruence alone.

runs.result_summary: The no-extra-condition recomposition correctly stopped at a one-zero family, exposed an independent angular degree of freedom, and identified its center without asserting it was actual.
